title: S11D 鐵礦綜合工程
summary: 以輸送帶運搬與天然含水率處理的鐵礦工程為例，比較系統邊界和資源效率。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
summaryEn: A conveyor-transport and natural-moisture processing iron-ore case compares system boundaries and resource efficiency. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 移動破碎到長距輸送的連續物料流；天然含水率處理的乾濕基區分；含鐵物料與品質受限堆料的分區
v31FocusEn: Continuous flow from mobile crushing to long conveyors; Dry/wet basis in natural-moisture processing; Segregating iron-bearing and quality-constrained stock

stages.titleEn: Resource conditions and system boundaries: S11D iron ore complex
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「移動破碎到長距輸送的連續物料流」與「天然含水率處理的乾濕基區分」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Continuous flow from mobile crushing to long conveyors" and "Dry/wet basis in natural-moisture processing": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「移動破碎到長距輸送的連續物料流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Continuous flow from mobile crushing to long conveyors" is correct?
options: 輸送帶容量由堆積密度、料流截面與帶速決定；截面取決於槽形與裝載，不等於帶寬乘料高的任意矩形。
輸送帶速度正常就表示輸送噸數正常。
一噸濕礦與一噸乾礦可以直接比較品位產能。
optionsEn: Belt capacity follows bulk density, loaded cross-section and belt speed.
Normal belt speed guarantees normal transported tonnage.
One wet tonne and one dry tonne can be directly compared for grade throughput.

quiz.explanationEn: Belt capacity follows bulk density, loaded cross-section and belt speed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 移動破碎到長距輸送的連續物料流：機制與資源流程
steps.titleEn: Continuous flow from mobile crushing to long conveyors: mechanism and resource flow
steps.objective: 說明「移動破碎到長距輸送的連續物料流」如何決定「S11D 鐵礦綜合工程」的物料、能量、量測或環境功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Continuous flow from mobile crushing to long conveyors” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “S11D iron ore complex”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 以「S11D 鐵礦綜合工程」作案例背景，本單元的原創桌上問題是「移動破碎到長距輸送的連續物料流」。輸送帶容量由堆積密度、料流截面與帶速決定；截面取決於槽形與裝載，不等於帶寬乘料高的任意矩形。連續運搬仍受轉運點、落料分布與停機連鎖限制，平均容量不能證明整條系統無瓶頸。 這是情境分析，不宣稱該工程使用下列合成數值。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Using S11D iron ore complex as the case setting, this original desk-based investigation addresses continuous flow from mobile crushing to long conveyors. Belt capacity follows bulk density, loaded cross-section and belt speed. Cross-section depends on trough geometry and loading, not an arbitrary width-height rectangle. Transfer points, feed distribution and linked downtime still constrain continuous transport, so average capacity does not prove an unconstrained system. This is scenario analysis and does not claim that the project uses the synthetic values below. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：以輸送帶運搬與天然含水率處理的鐵礦工程為例，比較系統邊界和資源效率。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。

quiz.question: 依「移動破碎到長距輸送的連續物料流」的模型 Q = 3600·ρb·A·v，輸送帶連續運搬的合成教學算例；輸入單位：rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s。不是該場址實測或操作值。最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model Q = 3600·ρb·A·v for "Continuous flow from mobile crushing to long conveyors", which value is closest to the synthetic teaching example for continuous belt transport; input units: rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s. These are not measured or operating values for this site.?
quiz.explanation: Q = 3600·ρb·A·v；代入 rho = 1.8 t/m³ bulk、A = 0.22 m²、v = 3.2 m/s，得 4,562 t/h（輸送帶連續運搬的合成教學算例；輸入單位：rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: Q = 3600·ρb·A·v; with rho = 1.8 t/m³ bulk, A = 0.22 m², v = 3.2 m/s the result is 4,562 t/h (synthetic teaching example for continuous belt transport; input units: rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s. These are not measured or operating values for this site.). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 移動破碎到長距輸送的連續物料流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Continuous flow from mobile crushing to long conveyors: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「移動破碎到長距輸送的連續物料流」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Continuous flow from mobile crushing to long conveyors” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Q = 3600·ρb·A·v；代入 rho = 1.8 t/m³ bulk、A = 0.22 m²、v = 3.2 m/s，得 4,562 t/h（輸送帶連續運搬的合成教學算例；輸入單位：rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 v 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Q = 3600·ρb·A·v; with rho = 1.8 t/m³ bulk, A = 0.22 m², v = 3.2 m/s the result is 4,562 t/h (synthetic teaching example for continuous belt transport; input units: rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s. These are not measured or operating values for this site.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise v by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：v 增加 10% 時，結果變為 5,018 t/h（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising v by 10% changes the result to 5,018 t/h (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 4,562 t/h（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 v 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 4,562 t/h (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in v with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: Q = 3600·ρb·A·v；代入 rho = 1.8 t/m³ bulk、A = 0.22 m²、v = 3.2 m/s，得 4,562 t/h（輸送帶連續運搬的合成教學算例；輸入單位：rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: v 增加 10% 時，結果變為 5,018 t/h（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising v by 10% changes the result to 5,018 t/h (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「移動破碎到長距輸送的連續物料流」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Continuous flow from mobile crushing to long conveyors"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
物料帳有差額就能立即斷定有實體洩漏。
針對「移動破碎到長距輸送的連續物料流」，使用合成的帶秤質量、帶速與料流截面重算，核對堆積密度的乾濕基；再以相同時間窗比較上下游流量。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Any balance residual immediately proves a physical leak.

For continuous flow from mobile crushing to long conveyors, recalculate synthetic belt-scale mass, speed and cross-section, checking wet/dry density basis and comparing upstream and downstream flows over identical time windows.
quiz.explanation: 針對「移動破碎到長距輸送的連續物料流」，使用合成的帶秤質量、帶速與料流截面重算，核對堆積密度的乾濕基；再以相同時間窗比較上下游流量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For continuous flow from mobile crushing to long conveyors, recalculate synthetic belt-scale mass, speed and cross-section, checking wet/dry density basis and comparing upstream and downstream flows over identical time windows. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 移動破碎到長距輸送的連續物料流：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Continuous flow from mobile crushing to long conveyors: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「移動破碎到長距輸送的連續物料流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Continuous flow from mobile crushing to long conveyors” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對「移動破碎到長距輸送的連續物料流」，使用合成的帶秤質量、帶速與料流截面重算，核對堆積密度的乾濕基；再以相同時間窗比較上下游流量。 提交控制體圖與有單位的資料表，讓另一位學徒能獨立重算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For continuous flow from mobile crushing to long conveyors, recalculate synthetic belt-scale mass, speed and cross-section, checking wet/dry density basis and comparing upstream and downstream flows over identical time windows. Submit a control-volume diagram and a table with units so another learner can recalculate independently. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用圖示列出每個轉運點的暫存量與容量；不讓學生靠近運轉輸送機做量測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Diagram inventory and capacity at each transfer point; learners use datasets rather than approaching operating conveyors.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在「移動破碎到長距輸送的連續物料流」情境，帶速正常但噸數下降，可能是空隙增加或落料不足；若上游滿載而下游偏低，則檢查轉運點累積與量測偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: In the scenario of continuous flow from mobile crushing to long conveyors, normal speed with lower tonnage may mean more voids or insufficient feed; full upstream loading with low downstream flow suggests transfer accumulation or measurement bias. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 在「移動破碎到長距輸送的連續物料流」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 在「移動破碎到長距輸送的連續物料流」情境，帶速正常但噸數下降，可能是空隙增加或落料不足；若上游滿載而下游偏低，則檢查轉運點累積與量測偏差。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
一噸濕礦與一噸乾礦可以直接比較品位產能。
optionsEn: In the scenario of continuous flow from mobile crushing to long conveyors, normal speed with lower tonnage may mean more voids or insufficient feed.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
One wet tonne and one dry tonne can be directly compared for grade throughput.
quiz.explanation: 在「移動破碎到長距輸送的連續物料流」情境，帶速正常但噸數下降，可能是空隙增加或落料不足；若上游滿載而下游偏低，則檢查轉運點累積與量測偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: In the scenario of continuous flow from mobile crushing to long conveyors, normal speed with lower tonnage may mean more voids or insufficient feed; full upstream loading with low downstream flow suggests transfer accumulation or measurement bias. steps.titleEn: Continuous flow from mobile crushing to long conveyors: failure diagnosis

steps.instructionEn: In the scenario of dry/wet basis in natural-moisture processing, more wet tonnes with unchanged metal may only reflect added water; dry mass, assay basis and rainfall records prevent a false capacity claim. Record which independent observation rules out an alternative cause. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, delivery, life or environment of “S11D iron ore complex”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這是情境分析，不宣稱該工程使用下列合成數值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This is scenario analysis and does not claim that the project uses the synthetic values below.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一噸濕礦與一噸乾礦可以直接比較品位產能。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One wet tonne and one dry tonne can be directly compared for grade throughput." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在「天然含水率處理的乾濕基區分」情境，濕噸增長但金屬量不變可能只是水分增加；核對乾重、化驗基準與降雨紀錄可避免誤報產能。 記錄哪一項獨立資料能排除替代原因。
knowledge.textEn: In the scenario of dry/wet basis in natural-moisture processing, more wet tonnes with unchanged metal may only reflect added water; dry mass, assay basis and rainfall records prevent a false capacity claim. Record which independent observation rules out an alternative cause.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.title: 證據版本
knowledge.text: 2026-11-10：核對官方工程識別與公開情境；算例由作者設定為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: 2026-11-10: Primary project identity and public context reviewed; numerical examples are authored teaching assumptions.
